{{Top|leg}}
During this '''skirmish''', the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jauxson]] and his [[Jauxson's pirate gang|gang]] were defeated by a band of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and their [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] allies in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Buerhoz]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. As a result, Jauxson was deposed as leader of his band, and the the Bith of the city and two others that had suffered under his depredations were freed.<ref name="CSWE II 142">{{CSWECite|II|142|Jauxson}}.</ref>
